items.title: Comparison of high-intensity laser therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy for the treatment of plantar flexor spasticity in post-stroke patients.
items.summary: This prospective, randomized, controlled, parallel-group clinical trial with 42 stroke patients compared high-intensity laser therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy, each combined with rehabilitation, versus rehabilitation alone, for treating plantar flexor spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后足底屈肌痉挛，这项研究显示，无论是高强度激光还是体外冲击波，只要结合康复治疗，效果都优于单独康复。可以考虑在常规康复方案中加入这两种模态。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法治疗卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 42 名卒中患者的前瞻性随机对照平行组临床试验比较了高强度激光疗法和体外冲击波疗法（均结合康复训练）与单独康复训练对治疗卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke plantar flexor spasticity, this study indicates that both high-intensity laser therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy, when combined with rehabilitation, are superior to rehabilitation alone. You should consider incorporating these modalities into your standard rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了单一结局指标（痉挛和步态参数），可能未能捕捉到患者整体功能改善或长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed single outcome measures (spasticity and gait parameters) and may not have captured overall functional improvement or long-term effects.

items.title: A single-session randomised crossover fNIRS study comparing three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms in healthy adults: a study protocol
items.summary: A single-session randomized crossover fNIRS study protocol comparing three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms and associated subjective experiences in healthy adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案详细描述了使用功能性近红外光谱技术 (fNIRS) 比较三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式的机制研究。虽然只是协议，但它预示了未来神经康复领域对镜像疗法生理机制理解的深化，这对于理解治疗的有效性边界至关重要。
items.titleZh: 一项单次随机交叉 fNIRS 研究方案，比较健康成人三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式
items.summaryZh: 一项单次随机交叉功能性近红外光谱 (fNIRS) 研究方案，旨在比较健康成人三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式及其相关主观体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol details a mechanistic study using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to compare three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms. Although it's only a protocol, it signals a deepening understanding of the physiological mechanisms of mirror therapy in neurorehabilitation, which is crucial for comprehending the boundaries of treatment effectiveness.
items.limitation: 此为研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and no actual results data are available yet.

items.title: Physical therapists as first-contact providers for musculoskeletal disorders: comparing beliefs across chiropractors, nurse practitioners, Physical therapists, and physician assistants.
items.summary: This cross-sectional survey compared the beliefs of chiropractors, nurse practitioners, physical therapists, and physician assistants regarding their capabilities, educational preparation, and scope of practice in providing first-contact care for musculoskeletal disorders.
items.curatedReason: PT 作为 MSKD 首诊提供者的作用日益重要，但这篇研究让你看到其他 FCPs（脊医、NP、PA）对此的看法。理解这些跨专业认知差异，有助于你推动 PT 的首诊整合。

items.curatedReasonEn: As PTs increasingly act as first-contact providers for MSKDs, this study reveals how other FCPs (chiropractors, NPs, PAs) perceive this role. Understanding these inter-professional belief differences can aid in promoting PT integration into first-contact care.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面调查，仅反映了特定时间点各专业人员的信念，无法推断因果关系或行为变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects professional beliefs at a specific point in time and cannot infer causality or changes in behavior.

items.title: The use of eHealth in primary physiotherapy care: a mixed-method study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study in Denmark explored eHealth use among 121 primary care physiotherapists, finding basic digital tools like email and phone were common, while more advanced technologies were rarely used due to perceived barriers.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了丹麦基层物理治疗师在肌肉骨骼护理中对数字工具的接受度。尽管基础沟通工具已普及，但更先进的远程医疗技术仍面临推广障碍，提示您在实践中应关注技术可及性与教育需求。

items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦混合方法研究调查了 121 名基层物理治疗师的远程医疗使用情况，发现电子邮件和电话等基础数字工具普及，但更先进技术因感知障碍而应用较少。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals Danish primary care physiotherapists' adoption of digital tools in musculoskeletal care. While basic communication tools are widespread, more advanced telehealth technologies face implementation barriers, suggesting a need to address accessibility and education in your practice.
items.limitation: 本研究采用混合方法设计，但其结果基于丹麦单一国家的数据，可能不完全适用于其他地区的临床实践。
items.limitationEn: This mixed-methods study is based on data from a single country (Denmark), which may limit its generalizability to clinical practices in other regions.

items.title: Functional Electrical Stimulation and Stroke Rehabilitation Research: The Critical Role of Sham Control Groups.
items.summary: A commentary discusses the critical role of sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) and stroke rehabilitation research, emphasizing the importance of rigorous study design.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了功能性电刺激（FES）卒中康复研究中设立安慰剂对照组的关键性。在评估 FES 干预效果时，确保研究设计严谨性对于得出可信结论至关重要，这对你解读 FES 相关研究的有效性提供了重要视角。
items.titleZh: 功能性电刺激与卒中康复研究：安慰剂对照组的关键作用
items.summaryZh: 一篇评论文章探讨了功能性电刺激（FES）在卒中康复研究中安慰剂对照组的关键作用，强调了严谨研究设计的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the critical role of sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) research for stroke rehabilitation. Ensuring rigorous study design is crucial for drawing credible conclusions when evaluating FES interventions, offering you an important perspective for interpreting the validity of FES-related studies.

items.title: Sensorimotor effects of heatwrap and exercise in acute low back pain: results of a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=99) found that heatwrap combined with exercise was more effective than sham heatwrap in improving pain sensitivity, lumbar muscle activity, current pain intensity, and trunk flexion range of motion in acute low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT验证了热敷结合运动对急性腰痛在减轻疼痛敏感性、改善腰部肌肉活动和躯干屈曲范围方面的益处。在处理急性腰痛时，你应将热敷与运动结合作为一线干预。
items.titleZh: 热敷结合运动对急性腰痛感觉运动效应的随机对照试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，对于急性腰痛患者，热敷结合运动在改善疼痛敏感性、腰部肌肉活动、疼痛强度和躯干屈曲范围方面优于单独热敷或安慰剂。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms the benefits of heatwrap combined with exercise for acute low back pain in reducing pain sensitivity, improving lumbar muscle activity, and increasing trunk flexion range of motion. For acute low back pain, you should incorporate combined heatwrap and exercise as a first-line intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心RCT，可能限制了结果的普遍性，且未报告长期随访结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center RCT, which may limit the generalizability of the findings, and long-term follow-up results were not reported.

items.title: Home-based digital exercise versus hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis: a propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study with dual-perspective cost-utility evaluation.
items.summary: A propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study in China found that a 12-week home-based digital exercise program was non-inferior to hospital-supervised physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis regarding first-step morning pain (adjusted mean difference -0.63 points, 95% CI -0.92 to -0.35; p < 0.001) and showed cost-utility advantages from both payer and societal perspectives.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对于足底筋膜炎，居家数字运动方案在临床疗效和成本效益上均不劣于医院物理治疗。这支持了远程康复在中国的应用潜力，为诊所和医院考虑如何拓展服务模式提供了重要依据。
items.titleZh: 居家数字运动与医院物理治疗治疗足底筋膜炎的对比：一项匹配回顾性队列研究及成本效益评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国进行的回顾性队列研究显示，为期12周的居家数字运动方案在治疗足底筋膜炎的临床疗效上不劣于医院物理治疗，且在成本效益方面更具优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that home-based digital exercise is non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis in both clinical effectiveness and cost-effectiveness. This supports the potential of telerehabilitation in China, offering crucial evidence for clinics and hospitals to expand their service models.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，且匹配算法无法完全消除所有混杂因素，结果可能存在选择偏倚。研究在中国三级医院进行，结果对其他国家或医疗环境的适用性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study, and propensity-score matching cannot eliminate all confounders, potentially introducing selection bias. Conducted in Chinese tertiary hospitals, the generalizability of results to other countries or healthcare settings needs further validation.

items.title: Feasibility study of gait analysis using a new Wearable Force Plate
items.summary: A feasibility study evaluated ShokacShoes, a novel sensorized shoe integrating three triaxial force sensors, demonstrating its usability for measuring three-dimensional ground reaction forces in gait analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这款新型可穿戴式力板鞋在步态分析中展现出可行性，解决了传统力板在真实环境中应用的局限。它有望成为你临床评估中新的移动工具，但需等待更多验证性研究。
items.titleZh: 新型可穿戴式力板进行步态分析的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项可行性研究评估了ShokacShoes，这是一种集成三个三轴力传感器的新型可穿戴式鞋，并证明了其在步态分析中测量三维地面反作用力的可用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This novel wearable force plate shoe demonstrates feasibility for gait analysis, addressing the limitations of traditional force plates in real-world settings. It holds promise as a new mobile tool for your clinical assessments, but requires further validation studies.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注新设备的可用性评估，样本量较小，且未与其他金标准设备进行直接的临床有效性对比，缺乏在病理人群中的大规模验证数据。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on evaluating the usability of the new device with a small sample size, lacked direct clinical effectiveness comparisons with gold standard devices, and did not include large-scale validation data in pathological populations.

items.title: Living with stroke-related visual impairment: a qualitative exploration of lived experience, self-management, and support needs.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the lived experiences of 16 community-dwelling adults in Scotland with stroke-related visual impairment (SRVI), identifying daily impact, self-management strategies, and unmet support needs.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后视力障碍（SRVI）患者，他们的真实生活挑战、自我管理策略和未满足的需求是临床中常被忽视的。这项针对16名苏格兰社区居民的定性研究，揭示了SRVI对功能、心理和社交的全面影响，提示我们在制定康复计划时，需要更细致地关注这些方面。
items.titleZh: 卒中相关视力障碍患者的生活：一项对生活经验、自我管理和支持需求的定性探索
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究对苏格兰 16 名社区居住的卒中相关视力障碍（SRVI）患者进行了访谈，以了解其日常生活影响、自我管理策略及未满足的支持需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with stroke-related visual impairment (SRVI), their real-life challenges, self-management strategies, and unmet needs are often overlooked in clinical practice. This qualitative study of 16 community-dwelling adults in Scotland reveals the comprehensive functional, psychological, and social impacts of SRVI, suggesting we need to pay closer attention to these aspects when developing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性观察，样本量较小（16 例），且受访者来自苏格兰一个区域，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative observational study has a small sample size (16 participants) and was conducted in a specific region of Scotland, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study found that Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training combined with physical therapy improved spatiotemporal gait parameters and overall gait quality in 52 children with cerebral palsy across different GMFCS levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，Lokomat 机器人步态训练结合物理治疗能改善脑瘫儿童的步态质量，尤其是对于不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿。这为临床实践中机器人辅助疗法的使用提供了进一步证据。
items.titleZh: Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗对脑瘫儿童步态质量的影响：一项按严重程度分层的分析
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究发现，52 名脑瘫儿童在接受 Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗后，其步态时空参数和整体步态质量均有所改善，且治疗效果在不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿中有所体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study indicates that Lokomat-based robotic gait training combined with physical therapy can improve gait quality in children with cerebral palsy, including those with varying motor impairment severities. This provides further evidence for the use of robotic-assisted therapy in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，存在固有的局限性，如数据缺失和无法控制的混杂因素，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, it has inherent limitations such as missing data and uncontrolled confounding factors, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: APTA Analysis Reveals Greater Long-Term Payment Gains in Medicare Proposal
items.summary: APTA's analysis suggests that the latest Medicare payment proposal could lead to greater long-term payment gains for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: APTA 的分析显示 Medicare 最新提案可能带来物理治疗师长期支付的增长。这直接影响您未来的报销收入，务必关注后续的具体政策细节和影响。
items.titleZh: APTA 分析揭示 Medicare 提案中长期支付增长潜力
items.summaryZh: APTA 的分析显示，Medicare 最新提案可能为物理治疗师带来更大的长期支付增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's analysis indicates that the latest Medicare proposal may lead to long-term payment increases for physical therapists. This directly impacts your future reimbursement revenue, so pay close attention to subsequent policy details and their implications.

items.title: Exploring animal-assisted therapy in stroke rehabilitation: a systematic review of emerging evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of 12 studies on animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in adult stroke rehabilitation found emerging evidence primarily for psychosocial and emotional benefits, with limited data on motor or cognitive outcomes due to varied study designs and small sample sizes.
items.curatedReason: 动物辅助疗法在卒中康复中的证据仍然有限且异质性高，尚不能支持作为常规干预。目前主要提示在心理社会和情感层面有潜在益处，但在运动或认知功能上尚无定论。继续以研究和辅助手段视角关注，别急于写入常规康复方案。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中动物辅助疗法：系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对12项研究的系统综述显示，动物辅助疗法在成人卒中康复中主要在新兴的心理社会和情感益处方面有初步证据，但由于研究设计多样和样本量小，在运动或认知结局方面数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in stroke rehabilitation remains limited and highly heterogeneous, not yet supporting its routine integration. Current findings primarily suggest potential benefits in psychosocial and emotional domains, with no definitive conclusions on motor or cognitive functions. Continue to view AAT as an area of research and an adjunctive approach, rather than integrating it into standard rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（12项），且设计多样、样本量小，限制了证据的综合性和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The small number of included studies (12), coupled with diverse designs and small sample sizes, limits the generalizability and synthesis of the evidence.

items.title: Association of the time from injury to surgery with postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study explored the association between the time from injury to surgery and the risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折的老年患者，受伤到手术的等待时间，可能影响他们术后发生急性心脑血管事件的风险。作为康复治疗师，这意味着你需要更积极地与多学科团队协作，推动患者在允许的情况下尽快手术，这间接支持了术前优化干预的必要性。
items.titleZh: 髋部骨折老年患者受伤至手术时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究探讨了髋部骨折老年患者从受伤到手术的时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件风险之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older patients with hip fracture, the time from injury to surgery might influence their risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events. As therapists, this implies a need for more proactive collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advocate for prompt surgery when medically appropriate, indirectly supporting the necessity of pre-operative optimization.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究可能存在混杂因素和信息偏差，且因果关系难以确定。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective cohort studies may be subject to confounding factors and information bias, and causal relationships are difficult to establish.

items.title: Tailoring Resistance Exercise for Knee Osteoarthritis: An Intervention Systematic Review With Dose-Response Meta-analysis of the Effects of Intensity and Volume.
items.summary: A systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of RCTs found dose-response relationships between isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume and outcomes of pain, function, and strength in people with knee osteoarthritis (OA), and compared different intensities and delivery methods.
items.curatedReason: 膝骨关节炎患者的下肢等张阻力训练，其容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间存在明确的剂量-反应关系。你可以根据这篇高质量系统综述的发现，更精准地调整患者的康复方案，包括训练强度和交付方式。
items.titleZh: 针对膝骨关节炎的个体化阻力训练：一项关于强度和容量效应的剂量-反应荟萃分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验进行的系统综述和剂量-反应荟萃分析，旨在评估膝骨关节炎患者等张下肢阻力训练的容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间的剂量-反应关系，并比较不同强度和实施方式的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee OA patients, isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume shows clear dose-response relationships with improvements in pain, function, and strength. Leverage this high-quality systematic review to fine-tune your rehabilitation protocols, including training intensity and delivery methods, for better patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 该综述未明确报告膝骨关节炎阻力训练的最佳长期剂量。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly report on the optimal long-term dosage for resistance training in knee osteoarthritis.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: The Efficacy of Exercise Therapy for Nonspecific Chronic Low Back Pain According to the FITT Principle: A Systematic Review With Meta-analyses.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analyses evaluated the efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, differing in frequency, intensity, type, and time (FITT), on disability in individuals with nonspecific chronic low back pain (LBP).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述及其荟萃分析，基于 FITT 原则，精细评估了不同运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的疗效。这为你调整慢性腰痛患者的运动处方提供了具体的证据指导，让你能更精准地优化干预参数。
items.titleZh: 基于 FITT 原则的运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛疗效的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了根据 FITT（频率、强度、类型、时间）原则调整的运动疗法，对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, specifically their FITT parameters (frequency, intensity, type, and time), for disability in nonspecific chronic low back pain patients has been systematically evaluated. This review offers concrete evidence to help you optimize exercise prescription parameters and more precisely manage these patients.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的异质性可能影响了 FITT 各组成部分特定推荐的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity among included studies may impact the precision of specific recommendations for each FITT component.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Musculoskeletal impairments associated with migraine in young adults: a case-control study.
items.summary: A case-control study involving 140 university students found associations between migraine and musculoskeletal impairments, including core and cervical muscle endurance, and craniovertebral angle.
items.curatedReason: 这项病例对照研究提示，偏头痛大学生可能存在核心肌耐力、颈肌耐力和颅椎角异常。临床上评估偏头痛患者时，别只关注头痛，也考虑这些潜在的肌肉骨骼因素。
items.titleZh: 青年偏头痛患者的肌肉骨骼障碍：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 140 名大学生进行的病例对照研究发现，偏头痛与核心肌耐力、颈肌耐力和颅椎角等肌肉骨骼障碍存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study suggests that university students with migraine may have impairments in core muscle endurance, cervical muscle endurance, and craniovertebral angle. When evaluating migraine patients, consider these potential musculoskeletal factors beyond just the headache.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例对照设计，无法确立因果关系，且受试者仅限于大学生人群，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This case-control study cannot establish causality, and its findings are limited to university students, restricting generalizability.

items.title: Biofeedback in Parkinson's disease: A systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that biofeedback added to practice significantly improves lower limb activity in individuals with Parkinson's disease compared to practice alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析证实，与单纯练习相比，结合生物反馈能显著改善帕金森病患者的下肢活动。因此，您在为这类患者制定治疗方案时，应该考虑纳入生物反馈技术以提升功能效果。
items.titleZh: 生物反馈在帕金森病中的应用：一项含 meta 分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 meta 分析的系统综述发现，在帕金森病患者中，联合实践的生物反馈比单独实践能显著改善下肢活动能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Biofeedback combined with practice shows significant benefits for improving lower limb activity in Parkinson's disease patients compared to practice alone, as supported by this meta-analysis. Clinicians should consider integrating biofeedback modalities into treatment plans for this population to enhance functional outcomes.
items.limitation: The meta-analysis includes randomized trials, but variations in biofeedback protocols and outcome measures across studies may introduce heterogeneity.
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis includes randomized trials, but variations in biofeedback protocols and outcome measures across studies may introduce heterogeneity.

items.title: REINA: A Recognize-Then-Infer Wearable-to-App AI Framework for Breast Cancer Rehabilitation
items.summary: The REINA AI framework uses wearable IMU data for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation, recognizing activities and inferring EMG signals for neuromuscular assessment.
items.curatedReason: REINA这个利用可穿戴设备的AI框架，通过推断神经肌肉活动来远程监测乳腺癌康复患者的运动功能，这听起来很吸引人。但作为临床实践，在广泛应用前，我们必须进一步验证其临床实用性及其在不同患者群体中的有效性。
items.titleZh: REINA：一种用于乳腺癌康复的识别-推断可穿戴设备到应用程序 AI 框架
items.summaryZh: REINA AI 框架利用可穿戴 IMU 数据对乳腺癌康复中的运动功能进行远程监测，识别活动并推断肌电信号以进行神经肌肉评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: REINA, a novel AI framework utilizing wearables, shows promise for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation by inferring neuromuscular activity. While this is an interesting technological advancement, its clinical utility and validation in diverse patient populations require further investigation before widespread adoption.
items.limitation: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.
items.limitationEn: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.

items.title: The effectiveness of instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization on pain and function in patients with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) found that instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) significantly improved pain (SMD -0.74; 95% CI -1.04 to -0.44) and function (SMD -0.66; 95% CI -0.99 to -0.34) in musculoskeletal disorders in the short term, with moderate effect sizes.
items.curatedReason: IASTM 对肌肉骨骼疾病的疼痛和功能确有短期改善，效果中等。这项纳入了14项RCTs、共550名患者的系统综述和荟萃分析，证实了 IASTM 可作为有效的辅助手段，但它并非解决所有问题的银弹，长期疗效尚无定论。
items.titleZh: 器械辅助软组织松动术对肌肉骨骼疾病患者疼痛和功能的有效性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项随机对照试验（n=550）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）在短期内显著改善了肌肉骨骼疾病患者的疼痛（SMD -0.74；95% CI -1.04 至 -0.44）和功能（SMD -0.66；95% CI -0.99 至 -0.34），效应量中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: IASTM does offer short-term, moderate improvements in pain and function for musculoskeletal disorders. This systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) confirms IASTM's role as an effective adjunct, but it's not a panacea, and its long-term efficacy remains undetermined.
items.limitation: 研究的异质性较高，且大多数纳入研究缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity, and most included studies lack long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Minimal Important Changes in Accelerometer-Measured Physical Activity and Sedentary Time in Older Patients With Subacute Stroke: A Multicenter Study.
items.summary: A multicenter observational study involving 299 subacute stroke patients estimated the minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured sedentary behavior, light-intensity physical activity, and moderate-to-vigorous intensity physical activity, ranging from 11.4 to 34.2 minutes, based on improvements in FIM scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究首次给出了亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变（MIC），为临床评估康复效果和设定目标提供了量化依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变：一项多中心研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 299 名亚急性卒中患者的多中心观察性研究估计了加速计测量的久坐行为、轻度身体活动和中高强度身体活动的最小重要改变（MIC），范围为 11.4 至 34.2 分钟，为康复效果评估提供了量化参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study provides the first estimates of minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured physical activity and sedentary time in older patients with subacute stroke, offering quantitative benchmarks for assessing rehabilitation effectiveness and setting treatment goals.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，依赖自我报告的锚点进行MIC估计。
items.limitationEn: The study's observational design relies on self-reported anchors for MIC estimation.

items.title: Feasibility, content and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale for chronic stroke survivors.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study with 66 chronic stroke survivors (median 81 years old, 76 months post-onset) confirmed the feasibility, content validity, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) using COSMIN standards, with high completion rates and good correlation to other functional measures.
items.curatedReason: 本研究证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）对慢性卒中幸存者的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，为你评估该群体功能受限的个体化目标提供了一个可靠工具。它解决了在慢性卒中语境下 PSFS 应用的痛点。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者患者特异性功能量表的可行性、内容效度和结构效度。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 66 名慢性卒中幸存者（中位年龄 81 岁，发病后 76 个月）的横断面研究，依据 COSMIN 标准证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，表现出高完成率和与其他功能测量工具的良好相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the feasibility, content, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) for chronic stroke survivors, providing a reliable tool for assessing individualized functional goals in this population. It addresses a key gap in PSFS application within chronic stroke contexts.
items.limitation: 研究人群年龄偏大，样本量相对有限，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study population was older, and the sample size was relatively limited, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Navigating recovery after flap repair for pressure injury in spinal cord injury/disorder: lived experience and clinician perspectives on complications, resilience, and care models.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the lived experiences of 8 individuals with SCI/D experiencing post-flap complications and 10 multidisciplinary clinicians, revealing themes of shifting realities, motivation through community, and the need for comprehensive, integrated care models in pressure injury recovery.
items.curatedReason: 对于SCI/D患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复，我们仍需更全面的整合照护模式。这项研究从8位患者和10位临床医生的经验中发现，除了生理挑战，患者面临的心理和社会现实转变、社群支持的激励作用同样不可忽视。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤/疾病患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复的探究：并发症、韧性和护理模式的患者与临床医生视角。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 8 名经历皮瓣修复并发症的脊髓损伤患者和 10 名多学科临床医生的经验，揭示了压疮恢复中现实转变、社区驱动的动力以及对全面综合护理模式的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: For SCI/D patients recovering from pressure injury flap repair, a more comprehensive, integrated care model is still needed. This study, drawing from the experiences of 8 patients and 10 clinicians, highlights that beyond physiological challenges, the psychological and social shifts patients face, and the motivating role of community support, are equally critical.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study with a small sample size, the generalizability of its findings is limited.

items.title: Co-design of a physical activity maintenance intervention for adults with stroke.
items.summary: A mixed-methods co-design study, involving 38 stakeholders in focus groups and 11 in workshops, developed a physical activity maintenance program for stroke survivors, identifying themes like shifting realities of PA post-stroke and motivation through community.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过共同设计方法，为卒中患者在社区康复后维持身体活动提供了干预方案的框架。它强调了将患者、照护者和临床医生纳入设计的重要性，未来有望转化为更符合实际需求的临床工具。
items.titleZh: 卒中成人身体活动维持干预的共同设计。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法共同设计研究，通过焦点小组（38 名参与者）和工作坊（11 名参与者）为卒中幸存者开发了身体活动维持计划，识别了卒中后身体活动的现实转变和社区驱动的动力等主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study provides a framework for physical activity maintenance interventions in stroke survivors post-community rehabilitation, highlighting the importance of involving patients, caregivers, and clinicians. This could lead to more clinically relevant tools in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为方案设计阶段，尚未进行干预实施与效果评估。
items.limitationEn: This study is in the intervention design phase; implementation and effectiveness evaluation are pending.

items.title: Fatigue in Neurological Rehabilitation: Why Brain Diversity and Population Diversity Matter.
items.summary: A commentary discusses the limitations in neurological fatigue research, noting that 95%-100% of studies rely on questionnaires and peripheral biomarkers, with fewer than 15% using functional neuroimaging, and highlights a lack of population diversity in cohorts.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评批判性地指出了神经康复领域对疲劳研究中“大脑多样性”和“人群多样性”的不足，提醒你关注评估工具的局限性及研究对象地域和族裔的代表性，以更好地理解和干预疲劳。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的疲劳：为什么大脑多样性和人群多样性至关重要。
items.summaryZh: 一篇述评探讨了神经疲劳研究的局限性，指出 95%-100% 的研究依赖问卷和外周生物标志物，功能神经影像学应用不足 15%，并强调了研究人群多样性的缺失。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically highlights deficiencies in "brain diversity" and "population diversity" in neurological rehabilitation fatigue research, urging you to consider the limitations of assessment tools and the representativeness of study populations for better understanding and intervention of fatigue.

items.title: Eight Functional outcomes, two dimensions: a cross-sectional analysis of scale dependence in spatiotemporal gait determinants after subacute stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 244 subacute stroke patients found that eight routinely used gait outcomes primarily represent two dimensions. Spatiotemporal gait parameters were analyzed to determine how determinants differ between these outcomes, suggesting some outcomes reflect similar constructs despite scale differences.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了亚急性卒中患者八种常用功能结局量表（如 BBS、步速、TUG）在评估步态时存在重叠和维度差异，这提示你在选择和解释步态结局指标时，要考虑量表间的关联性，避免重复评估。
items.titleZh: 八种功能结局，两个维度：亚急性卒中后时空步态决定因素的量表依赖性横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 244 名亚急性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，八种常用的步态结局指标主要代表两个维度。分析了时空步态参数以确定不同结局指标的决定因素差异，表明尽管量表不同，部分结局反映了相似的结构。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals overlaps and dimensional differences among eight commonly used functional outcome measures (e.g., BBS, gait velocity, TUG) for gait assessment in subacute stroke. This suggests that you should consider the interrelations between scales when selecting and interpreting gait outcome measures to avoid redundant assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法评估结局量表随时间的动态变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design and cannot assess dynamic changes in outcome measures over time.

items.title: Implementing an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in oldest-old nursing home residents: protocol for a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial (SCOPE Study)
items.summary: This article presents the protocol for the SCOPE Study, a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial designed to implement an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, aiming to provide evidence for effective strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案描述了一个针对最老年住院养老院居民的肌少症干预措施，未来有望为这群高危人群的运动处方提供实证依据。目前阶段，它提示你关注肌少症在养老院的干预潜力。
items.titleZh: 针对最老年养老院居民肌少症运动干预的实施方案：一项实用性整群随机对照试验（SCOPE 研究）方案。
items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了 SCOPE 研究方案，这是一项旨在针对最老年养老院居民实施肌少症运动干预的实用性整群随机对照试验，旨在为有效策略提供证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol describes an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, which could provide evidence for exercise prescriptions in this high-risk population. At this stage, it highlights the potential for sarcopenia interventions in nursing homes.

items.title: Patient factors influencing participation in aerobic exercise during inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation post stroke: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study aimed to determine whether depressive symptoms, apathy, self-efficacy, outcome expectations, perceived barriers, or past exercise history were associated with aerobic exercise participation in stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者能否坚持有氧运动，可能与抑郁、冷漠、自我效能感、结果预期、感知障碍和过往锻炼史有关。这意味着你评估患者时，应多关注这些心理社会因素，而不仅仅是生理功能。
items.titleZh: 卒中后住院和门诊康复期间影响患者参与有氧运动的因素：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究旨在确定抑郁症状、冷漠、自我效能、运动结果预期、感知障碍或过往运动史是否与卒中康复期间有氧运动参与度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Whether stroke patients adhere to aerobic exercise may be linked to depression, apathy, self-efficacy, outcome expectations, perceived barriers, and past exercise history. When evaluating patients, you should focus more on these psychosocial factors, not just physiological function.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性队列研究，虽然能观察关联，但无法确定因果关系，且研究人群局限于城市医院患者。
items.limitationEn: This prospective cohort study can observe associations but cannot determine causality, and the study population is limited to patients in urban hospitals.

items.title: Mechanical elements related to the development of patellofemoral pain syndrome, pain intensity, and functional disability: A cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study compared proximal, local, and distal mechanical characteristics between individuals with and without patellofemoral pain syndrome (PFPS) and investigated their association with pain intensity and functional disability.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究识别了髌股疼痛综合征（PFPS）相关的近端、局部和远端力学因素，能帮你更全面地评估 PFPS 患者，指导个性化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 与髌股疼痛综合征发展、疼痛强度和功能障碍相关的力学因素：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究比较了髌股疼痛综合征（PFPS）患者与健康对照组的近端、局部和远端力学特征，并探讨了它们与疼痛强度和功能障碍的关联。
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在混杂因素未被完全控制。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and may have unaddressed confounding factors.

items.title: A domain-specific approach to characterizing balance confidence post-stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis confirmed that the Activities-Specific Balance Confidence (ABC) scale consists of three factors—anticipatory control, walking balance, and reactive balance—in 248 community-dwelling adults with chronic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究证实了卒中后平衡信心（ABC 量表）在三个特定领域存在结构。下次评估卒中患者的平衡信心时，可以多关注这三个维度：预期控制、步行平衡和反应性平衡。
items.titleZh: 卒中后平衡信心的领域特定特征：一项研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面分析对 248 名慢性卒中患者的现有数据进行研究，证实了“活动特异性平衡信心量表”（ABC 量表）包含预期控制、步行平衡和反应性平衡三个因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirmed the structural integrity of balance confidence (ABC scale) post-stroke across three specific domains. When assessing balance confidence in stroke patients, consider these three dimensions: anticipatory control, walking balance, and reactive balance.
items.limitation: 本研究是对现有数据的横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional analysis of existing data, which precludes causal inference and may be subject to reporting bias.

items.title: The association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found a significant positive association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults, emphasizing the importance of IC in geriatric health assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了内在能力（IC）与社区老年人生活质量（QOL）之间的关联。IC 概念是 WHO 的核心框架，这一发现再次确认了它在评估老年人健康中的重要性，可用于指导老年康复的评估和干预策略。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人内在能力与生活质量的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，社区老年人的内在能力与生活质量之间存在显著正相关，强调了内在能力在老年健康评估中的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the association between intrinsic capacity (IC) and quality of life (QOL) in community-dwelling older adults. As IC is a core WHO framework, this finding reconfirms its importance in assessing older adult health, guiding geriatric rehabilitation assessment and intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立内在能力与生活质量之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, precluding the establishment of causality between intrinsic capacity and quality of life.

items.title: Clinical sensory tests in professional practice: a web-based survey on awareness and challenges among Italian physicians and physiotherapists.
items.summary: A cross-sectional web-based survey among Italian physicians and physiotherapists identified self-reported perceptions, preferred approaches, and perceived barriers to clinical sensory testing in practice.
items.curatedReason: 这项意大利调查揭示了物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知和实践障碍。对美国、中国、澳大利亚的临床实践借鉴意义有限，但可作为同类实践调研的参考。
items.titleZh: 意大利医师和物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知与挑战：一项网络调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对意大利执业医师和物理治疗师的横断面网络调查，旨在描述他们对临床感觉测试的自我感知、偏好方法以及感知到的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Italian survey identifies physiotherapists' perceptions and practice barriers regarding clinical sensory testing. While its direct relevance to clinical practice in the US, China, or Australia is limited, it can serve as a reference for similar practice surveys.
items.limitation: 本研究为意大利执业医师和物理治疗师的自填式网络问卷调查，可能存在选择偏倚和回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a self-reported web-based survey among Italian physicians and physiotherapists, which may be subject to selection and recall bias.

items.title: Characteristics of Outpatient Care Settings Associated with Implementation Outcomes for a Group Physical Therapy Program.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a cluster randomized hybrid implementation trial identified organizational and contextual characteristics associated with the successful adoption and implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments.
items.curatedReason: 在 VHA 体系内推行膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗，成功与否取决于特定的组织和背景因素，本研究对此提供了深入观察。对于希望推广类似小组治疗模式的科室，应重点关注这19个 VHA 门诊 PT 部门在人员配备、领导支持和流程优化方面的经验。
items.titleZh: 门诊护理环境中与小组物理治疗项目实施结果相关的特征
items.summaryZh: 一项针对集群随机混合 III 型实施试验的二次分析，在 19 个 VHA 门诊物理治疗部门中，评估了组织和背景特征与膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗项目实施（如采纳率）之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Successful implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis within the VHA hinges on specific organizational and contextual factors, as this study observes. For departments looking to adopt similar group models, prioritize insights from these 19 VHA outpatient PT departments regarding staffing, leadership support, and process optimization.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于 VHA 门诊物理治疗部门，其结果外推到其他医疗系统或私立诊所时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was confined to VHA outpatient physical therapy departments, limiting generalizability to other healthcare systems or private practices.

items.title: Operational AI Adoption in U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities: Organizational Selection and Domain Heterogeneity, 2021-2024
items.summary: U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are increasingly adopting operational AI solutions between 2021 and 2024, driven by workforce shortages and the complex Medicare prospective payment system, with varied adoption across clinical domains.
items.curatedReason: 这份报告显示美国住院康复机构（IRF）正在加速采用 AI，特别是在劳动力短缺和 Medicare 复杂报销压力下。它提示你，AI 在IRF 的应用正从早期尝试转向运营实践，你所在机构的未来运营模式可能会因此改变。
items.titleZh: 美国住院康复机构的运营级 AI 采用：组织选择与领域异质性，2021-2024
items.summaryZh: 受劳动力短缺和复杂 Medicare 预付款制度驱动，美国住院康复机构（IRFs）在2021至2024年间加速采用运营级 AI 解决方案，不同临床领域的采用情况存在异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This report shows that U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are accelerating AI adoption, particularly under workforce shortages and complex Medicare reimbursement pressures. It suggests that AI applications in IRFs are shifting from early trials to operational practice, potentially altering future operating models for your facility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Person-centred working relationships that focus on the unique goals of the individual are the heart of supported self-management: a qualitative study with stroke survivors.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 stroke survivors in England found that person-centered working relationships are at the heart of supported self-management during community stroke rehabilitation, focusing on individual goals and the "long and winding journey of self-management."
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调，卒中康复中支持性自我管理的核心是个性化工作关系。它提醒你，在与卒中幸存者建立康复联盟时，要专注于他们的独特目标，并将其作为长期自我管理的关键。
items.titleZh: 以个体为中心的工作关系是卒中幸存者支持性自我管理的核心：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国21名卒中幸存者的定性研究发现，以个体为中心的工作关系是社区卒中康复中支持性自我管理的核心，强调聚焦个体独特目标是长期自我管理的关键。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that person-centered working relationships are crucial for supported self-management in stroke rehabilitation. It reminds you to focus on unique individual goals when building therapeutic alliances with stroke survivors, framing it as key to long-term self-management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（21名卒中幸存者），结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (21 stroke survivors), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Reframing patient expectations as therapeutic targets in musculoskeletal care.
items.summary: This professional practice article argues that patient expectations (PEs) are not merely prognostic indicators but modifiable, multidimensional therapeutic targets that extend beyond treatment and recovery to influence outcomes in musculoskeletal care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专业实践文章提醒你，患者期望不只是预后因素，更是可主动干预的治疗靶点。在骨科 / 肌肉骨骼康复中，你需要更重视其对治疗效果的影响。
items.titleZh: 重构患者期望为肌肉骨骼康复中的治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章指出，患者期望（PEs）不仅是预后指标，更是可被调整、多维度的治疗靶点，其影响超越治疗和康复本身，在肌肉骨骼护理中能塑性治疗效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This professional practice article reminds you that patient expectations are not just prognostic factors but modifiable therapeutic targets. In orthopedic/musculoskeletal rehabilitation, you need to pay more attention to their impact on treatment outcomes.

items.title: Towards global standards in stroke rehabilitation and recovery: An international evaluation of practice alignment.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study evaluated how Centres of Clinical Excellence criteria align with routine clinical practice in 15 international stroke rehabilitation centers from 10 countries, exploring contextual factors influencing practices across diverse health systems.
items.curatedReason: 这项国际性混合方法研究揭示了全球卒中康复中心在实践中与卓越临床标准的一致性，为你了解不同卫生系统下的实践差异提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 迈向全球卒中康复和恢复标准：一项实践一致性的国际评估
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究评估了来自 10 个国家 15 个国际卒中康复中心在日常临床实践中与卓越临床标准的一致性，并探讨了影响不同卫生系统实践的背景因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This international mixed-methods study reveals the alignment of stroke rehabilitation centers with clinical excellence criteria, offering insights into practice variations across diverse health systems.
items.limitation: 研究设计为混合方法，可能存在选择偏倚，且无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The mixed-methods study design may introduce selection bias and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Carrying an unseen weight: the neuro-perceptual landscape of limb heaviness after stroke- a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified perceived limb heaviness as an under-recognized stroke symptom, often unrelated to weakness or spasticity. Proposed mechanisms include altered sensorimotor integration, impaired proprioception, and disrupted body representation, suggesting issues in sensorimotor processing.
items.curatedReason: 中风后肢体沉重感常常被忽视，但它可能提示感觉运动整合异常或本体感觉受损。本综述是梳理这一现象的首批尝试之一，为理解其机制和制定康复策略提供了基础。
items.titleZh: 中风后肢体沉重感的神经感知图景：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述指出，中风后感知到的肢体沉重感是一个未被充分认识的症状，可能与感觉运动整合异常、本体感觉受损和身体表征障碍等机制有关，而非单纯的无力或痉挛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke limb heaviness is an often-overlooked symptom, potentially indicating altered sensorimotor integration or impaired proprioception. This review is among the first to map this phenomenon, providing a foundation for understanding its mechanisms and developing rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能提供干预措施的疗效证据。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study does not provide evidence on the efficacy of interventions.

items.title: Application of non-invasive electroencephalogram-based brain-computer interfaces in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation.
items.summary: This article reviews the application of non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI) for post-stroke hand function rehabilitation. BCI decodes imagined hand movements to drive exoskeletons, FES, or VR devices, aiming to remodel neural pathways and promote motor recovery.
items.curatedReason: 对于传统康复手段效果不佳的中风手功能障碍患者，基于非侵入性脑电图的脑机接口（BCI）有望通过实时解码运动意图并驱动外部设备，促进神经通路重塑和运动恢复。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性脑电图脑机接口在中风后手功能康复中的应用

items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients with hand dysfunction who do not respond to conventional rehabilitation, non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising avenue. items.limitation: 本综述主要关注技术原理和应用潜力，未提供具体临床试验结果或疗效数据。
items.limitationEn: This review primarily focuses on technical principles and potential applications, without providing specific clinical trial results or efficacy data.

items.title: Strengthening Cardiac Rehabilitation: Key Strategies for Enhancing Accessibility and Outcomes

items.titleZh: 加强心脏康复：提高可及性和成果的关键策略

items.curatedReasonEn: Improving accessibility and adherence to cardiac rehabilitation is crucial for better patient outcomes. This study, by interviewing leaders of high-performing cardiac rehab programs, summarizes successful strategies that can provide practical references for your program's improvement.

items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative interview study with a small sample size based on leaders' subjective perspectives, which may have selection bias and limited generalizability.

items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者白质弥散各向异性与多学科住院康复效果：一项弥散张量成像分析

items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and primarily focuses on white matter diffusion anisotropy, potentially not fully accounting for other factors influencing rehabilitation response.

items.title: Impact of Social Determinants of Health on Physical Therapy Utilization in Home Health and Outpatient Settings: A Retrospective Cohort Study.

items.titleZh: 社会健康决定因素对居家和门诊物理治疗利用率的影响：一项回顾性队列研究

items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that socioeconomic status, residence, and hospital characteristics are significantly associated with PT utilization after total hip/knee replacement. items.limitationEn: This retrospective cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality and uses Medicare data, which may not represent all patient populations.

items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracolumbar fascia injury is an independent predictor of long-term residual low back pain 3 months after percutaneous kyphoplasty for thoracolumbar osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures. items.limitationEn: The study design is observational, preventing causal conclusions, and the accuracy and clinical utility of the predictors require further prospective validation.

items.title: The effect of static and dynamic core exercises on serve and spike speed in young volleyball players: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that both static and dynamic core exercises improved serve and spike speed in young volleyball players, with dynamic exercises showing greater benefits.

items.titleZh: 静态和动态核心练习对年轻排球运动员发球和扣球速度的影响：一项随机对照试验

items.title: Effects of Aquatic Tai Chi and Computer Assisted Rehabilitation Environment-Based Virtual Reality Training on Rehabilitation in Patients with Parkinson Disease: A Randomized Controlled Trial.

items.titleZh: 评估腰部核心肌群协同激活的方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述批判性地评估了当前评估腰部核心肌群协同激活的方法，将其分为表面肌电图和协同收缩指数计算等类别，并重点分析了其理论基础、技术特点、解释价值、局限性和实践适用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing lumbar core muscle co-activation, be wary of the limitations of surface EMG and co-contraction indices. This review highlights that current methods still face numerous challenges in theoretical basis, technical characteristics, and clinical interpretation; do not draw firm conclusions easily.
items.limitation: 本篇为叙述性综述，可能未进行全面的系统性文献检索和质量评估，存在潜在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may not have performed a comprehensive systematic literature search and quality appraisal, leading to potential biases.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the emergency department (RESHAP-ED): a randomised controlled trial with economic evaluation.
items.summary: The RESHAP-ED pragmatic RCT evaluated physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in five Australian emergency departments, demonstrating improved effectiveness, safety, and cost-effectiveness compared to usual care.
items.curatedReason: 这项在澳大利亚急诊科进行的 RCT 明确显示，物理治疗师主导的医疗模式可有效缩短患者在急诊科的等待时间，并降低医疗费用。在你的执业实践中，这进一步支持了 PT 在急诊分流中的重要作用。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师主导的急诊科肌肉骨骼疾病诊疗模式（RESHAP-ED）：一项随机对照试验及经济学评价
items.summaryZh: RESHAP-ED 是一项开放标签、实用性随机试验，在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的五个急诊科招募了肌肉骨骼疾病患者。该研究比较了物理治疗师主导的诊疗模式与常规护理的有效性、安全性及成本效益，结果显示物理治疗师主导的模式表现更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT from Australian emergency departments clearly shows that physiotherapist-led care effectively reduces ED length of stay and healthcare costs. In practice, this further supports the crucial role of PTs in emergency department triage.
items.limitation: 研究在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的五个急诊科进行，结果的外推性可能受限于特定医疗系统和地区。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in five emergency departments in New South Wales, Australia, so the generalizability of the findings may be limited by the specific healthcare system and region.

items.title: Effects of short-term compression in people with knee osteoarthritis: A sham-controlled randomised trial.
items.summary: A three-arm sham-controlled RCT (n=90) found that short-term elastic bandage compression did not significantly improve pain or physical function in knee osteoarthritis patients compared to sham compression or no bandaging at Day 6, 12 or 24 weeks post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 本项 RCT 发现膝关节骨性关节炎患者短期使用弹性绷带进行压迫，在疼痛和功能改善方面不优于安慰性压迫或无压迫。在实践中，它提示你无需将压迫疗法作为 OA 的常规干预手段。
items.titleZh: 短期压迫疗法对膝骨关节炎患者的效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂假对照随机对照试验（n=90）发现，在为期 6 天的干预后，短期弹性绷带压迫疗法在膝关节骨性关节炎患者的疼痛强度和身体功能方面，未显示出优于安慰性压迫或无压带的显著改善，且效果在 12 和 24 周后亦未显现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that short-term knee compression with elastic bandages did not offer superior pain or function improvement compared to sham compression or no bandaging in knee OA patients. It suggests that compression therapy is not a primary intervention for OA.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期较长（24 周），但短期（6 天）干预的效果未能持续。
items.limitationEn: Although the follow-up period was long (24 weeks), the short-term (6-day) intervention effects did not persist.

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying factors across public and private sectors.
items.curatedReason: 非特异性腰痛指南依从性差？这项定性研究发现，加拿大物理治疗师在依从指南时面临的障碍与促成因素，公立和私立部门都有其特点。这提示我们，优化本地诊所的指南依从性，需细致考量具体执业环境。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍与促成因素定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究深入探讨了加拿大物理治疗师在公共和私营部门执业中，依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南所面临的环境障碍和促成因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Poor adherence to non-specific low back pain guidelines? This qualitative study reveals specific environmental barriers and facilitators faced by Canadian PTs, with differences noted across public and private sectors. To improve guideline adherence in your local clinic, you'll need to consider your specific practice environment carefully.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，且结果可能受到研究者偏倚的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, and the findings may be influenced by researcher bias.

items.title: Revisional augmentation of residual neuromusculature and training facilitate embodiment and control of a bionic knee prosthesis
items.summary: This interventional study with two individuals with above-knee amputation showed that surgical revision to restore agonist-antagonist muscle relationships, combined with bionic knee prosthesis training, improved embodiment, control, and sensorimotor integration.
items.curatedReason: 对于大腿截肢患者，这项针对 2 人的研究提示，通过手术重建拮抗肌群关系并结合仿生膝假肢训练，可显著提升躯体感知、控制力及感觉运动整合。虽然样本量小，但这为未来仿生假肢和神经接口的整合提供了明确方向。
items.titleZh: 残留神经肌肉的翻修增强和训练促进了仿生膝关节假体的具身化和控制
items.summaryZh: 这项对两名膝上截肢者的介入性研究表明，通过手术翻修重建残余肌肉的激动-拮抗关系，并结合仿生膝关节假体训练，显著改善了假体的具身化、控制和感觉运动整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: For above-knee amputees, this 2-person study suggests that surgical revision to restore agonist-antagonist muscle relationships, combined with bionic knee prosthesis training, can significantly improve embodiment, control, and sensorimotor integration. Though a small sample, it points to a clear direction for integrating bionic prosthetics and neural interfaces.
items.limitation: 本研究仅涉及两名膝上截肢者，样本量极小，且为初步的介入性研究，结果的普适性需要更多大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study involved only two above-knee amputees, representing an extremely small sample size and a preliminary interventional study, so the generalizability of the results requires validation by larger-scale research.

items.title: Selective differences in eccentric inter-limb mechanics during single-leg vertical jump six months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=44) investigated eccentric inter-limb mechanics during single-leg vertical jumps six months post-ACLR, identifying selective differences in peak eccentric force, impulse, and velocity compared to controls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示了 ACLR 术后 6 个月单腿跳跃中患肢与健肢的离心力学差异，这进一步强调了双侧不对称对重返运动的潜在风险。将其作为你评估 ACLR 患者重返运动准备情况时的参考依据。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后六个月单腿垂直跳跃中患健肢离心力学的选择性差异
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=44）调查了前交叉韧带重建术后六个月单腿垂直跳跃时的患健肢离心力学特征，发现患肢在峰值离心力、离心冲量和离心速度上存在选择性差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals eccentric inter-limb mechanical differences during single-leg jumps 6 months post-ACLR, highlighting potential risks from bilateral asymmetry for return to sport. Use this as a reference when assessing ACLR patients' readiness for return to sport.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于男性参与者，且仅在 ACLR 术后 6 个月进行了一次评估，可能无法反映长期变化和更广泛人群的特点。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to male participants and only assessed at 6 months post-ACLR, which may not reflect long-term changes or broader population characteristics.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Clinical Decision Making in Pediatric Physiotherapy: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped the literature on clinical decision-making in pediatric physiotherapy (ages 0-18), identifying frameworks and factors influencing therapists' decisions across 22 studies.
items.curatedReason: 儿科物理治疗的临床决策复杂性高，这篇综述总结了 22 项研究，勾勒出影响儿科治疗师决策的框架和关键因素。在评估和干预 0-18 岁患者时，需特别关注发育差异性和以家庭为中心的护理。
items.titleZh: 儿科物理治疗中的临床决策：一项范围界定性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围界定性综述绘制了儿科物理治疗（0-18岁）中临床决策的文献图谱，识别了研究中使用的框架以及影响治疗师决策的因素，共纳入 22 项研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric clinical decision-making is complex. This scoping review, synthesizing 22 studies, outlines frameworks and key factors influencing therapists' decisions for ages 0-18. When assessing and intervening with this population, prioritize developmental variability and family-centered care.
items.limitation: 作为范围界定性综述，它主要描绘了文献现状，并未对证据质量进行严格评估或提供综合结论。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it primarily maps the literature and does not rigorously assess evidence quality or provide synthesized conclusions.

items.title: RObotic WAlking for children who CAnnot WAlk (RoWaCaWa): Impacts on Physical Function and Physical Activity from a 12-week robotic walking intervention
items.summary: A single-arm mixed-methods interventional study examined the impact of 12 weeks of robotic walking on physical function and inactivity sequelae in children with pediatric-onset neuromotor impairments, using outcomes like Goal Attainment Scale and physical activity measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对不能行走的儿童的机器人步态训练研究，提示了 12 周干预对身体功能和活动水平的改善。对于患有神经运动障碍的儿童，这进一步支持了机器人辅助训练在改善步态、实现康复目标中的应用潜力。
items.titleZh: RObotic WAlking for children who CAnnot WAlk (RoWaCaWa)：12 周机器人步态干预对身体功能和身体活动的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项单臂混合方法干预性研究，旨在探讨 12 周机器人步态训练对患有儿科神经运动障碍、无法行走的儿童的身体功能和不活动后遗症的影响，并采用目标达成量表和身体活动测量等指标进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This robotic walking study for children who cannot walk suggests improvements in physical function and activity levels after a 12-week intervention. For children with neuromotor impairments, this further supports the potential of robot-assisted training in improving gait and achieving rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂混合方法干预性研究，缺乏对照组，因此无法确定观察到的改善是否直接归因于机器人步态训练。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-arm mixed-methods interventional study without a control group, so the observed improvements cannot be definitively attributed to robotic walking intervention.

items.title: How Clinics Can Support Their Billing Teams in the Era of Payer Complexity
items.summary: This WebPT blog post discusses strategies for clinics to support their billing teams amidst increasing payer complexity, aiming to optimize reimbursement processes and operational efficiency.
items.curatedReason: 在支付方规则日益复杂的当下，WebPT 这篇博文提醒我们，诊所必须有效支持其账单团队。你需要审视诊所的报销流程，并考虑如何通过优化管理来提高运营效率，以确保收入最大化。
items.titleZh: 诊所如何在支付方日益复杂的时代支持其账单团队
items.summaryZh: WebPT 的这篇博客文章探讨了在支付方复杂性不断增加的背景下，诊所应如何支持其账单团队，旨在优化报销流程和提高运营效率。
items.curatedReasonEn: With increasing payer complexity, this WebPT blog post underscores the necessity for clinics to effectively support their billing teams. You should review your clinic's reimbursement processes and consider optimizing management to enhance operational efficiency and maximize revenue.
items.limitation: 这是一篇博客文章，内容基于行业经验和观点，而非严谨的研究证据或官方政策变动，因此其建议可能不具备普适性和权威性。
items.limitationEn: This is a blog post based on industry experience and opinions, not rigorous research evidence or official policy changes, so its recommendations may not be universally applicable or authoritative.

items.title: Outcome measures used in studies of vestibular rehabilitation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified outcome measures used in vestibular rehabilitation for adults with stroke, searching MEDLINE, Embase, and PEDro up to June 2026. It mapped and grouped outcomes by primary construct, calculating the frequency of use for each measure.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述提供了中风后前庭康复结局测量的概览，但强调了其异质性。在设计临床研究或选择疗效评估工具时，这有助于你避免“只关注步行”的偏见，确保评估的全面性。
items.titleZh: 中风后前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量指标：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统检索了截至2026年6月的中风成人前庭康复研究，旨在识别和映射所使用的结局测量指标。研究根据主要结构对结局进行分组，并计算了各测量指标的使用频率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review provides an overview of outcome measures in vestibular rehabilitation post-stroke, highlighting their heterogeneity. This helps you avoid a 'walking-only' bias when designing studies or selecting assessment tools, ensuring comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 本综述未对各结局测量工具的测量学特性（如信效度）进行评估。
items.limitationEn: This review did not evaluate the psychometric properties (e.g., reliability, validity) of the outcome measures.

items.title: Beyond Conventional Therapy in Parkinson's Disease Patients: The Impact of Visual Feedback Training on Balance and Trunk Control - A Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-week program combining conventional physiotherapy with visual-feedback balance and trunk-control training improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in 21 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn and Yahr stages 1-3).
items.curatedReason: 将视觉反馈训练与常规物理治疗结合，可改善帕金森病患者的平衡和躯干控制。将其作为你工具箱的补充选项，特别是对于姿势不稳和跌倒风险高的患者。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者超越传统疗法：视觉反馈训练对平衡和躯干控制的影响——一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 周、结合常规物理治疗与视觉反馈平衡和躯干控制训练的项目，改善了 21 名帕金森病（Hoehn and Yahr 1-3 期）患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Combining visual feedback training with conventional physiotherapy can improve balance and trunk control in Parkinson's disease patients. Consider this as a supplementary option in your toolkit, especially for those with high postural instability and fall risk.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心前瞻性队列研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing exclusion of placebo effects.

items.title: Measurement properties of a 300-m community-based walking test incorporating environmental walking demands in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.summary: The 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) demonstrated good test-retest reliability (ICC 2,1 ≥ 0.94) and small minimal detectable change (≤ 16.5 m) in 26 individuals with subacute stroke, reflecting environmental walking demands.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）在亚急性卒中患者中的可靠性，为你评估患者在真实环境中的步行能力提供了有效的工具。
items.titleZh: 纳入环境步行需求的 300 米社区步行测试在亚急性卒中患者中的测量学特性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了 26 名亚急性卒中患者的 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）的测量学特性，显示出良好的重测信度（ICC 2,1 ≥ 0.94）和小的最小可检测变化（≤ 16.5 米），能反映环境步行需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the reliability of the 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) in subacute stroke patients, offering you an effective tool for assessing real-world walking ability.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性分析前瞻性数据的研究，样本量有限，且未提供关于测试对治疗效果敏感性的信息。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data had a limited sample size and did not provide information on the test's responsiveness to treatment effects.

items.title: Atlantoaxial Instability in older adults: an underrecognized condition beyond rheumatoid arthritis – a retrospective study
items.summary: This retrospective study highlights atlantoaxial instability (AAI) as an underrecognized condition in older adults beyond rheumatoid arthritis, suggesting a need for increased awareness and evaluation in this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提醒你关注老年人寰枢关节不稳（AAI）的问题，它可能在类风湿关节炎之外被低估。对于伴有颈部症状或跌倒风险的老年患者，要将 AAI 纳入鉴别诊断，进行更细致的评估。
items.titleZh: 老年人寰枢关节不稳：一个在类风湿关节炎之外未被充分认识的状况——一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究强调，寰枢关节不稳（AAI）是老年人群中除类风湿关节炎外一个未被充分认识的状况，提示需要提高对该人群 AAI 的认知和评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study reminds you to pay attention to atlantoaxial instability (AAI) in older adults, which might be underrecognized beyond rheumatoid arthritis. For elderly patients with neck symptoms or fall risk, include AAI in your differential diagnosis and conduct a more thorough assessment.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，存在回顾性偏倚，且未提供治疗干预效果的数据。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective study, subject to recall bias, and did not provide data on the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions.

items.title: Effect of Global Postural Re-Education in Individuals With Text Neck Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that Global Postural Re-Education (GPR) combined with conventional physical therapy significantly improved craniovertebral/shoulder angles, pain (VAS), and cervical ROM compared to conventional therapy alone in individuals with text neck syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于体态性颈痛，GPR 联合常规疗法可能在改善颈肩角度、缓解疼痛和增加活动度方面优于单独的常规疗法。这支持将 GPR 作为现有方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 姿势再教育对“低头族”颈痛综合征患者疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，对于“低头族”颈痛综合征患者，全局姿势再教育（GPR）联合常规物理治疗在改善颈椎和肩部角度、疼痛（VAS）以及颈椎活动度方面，显著优于单独常规物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that GPR combined with conventional therapy may be superior to conventional therapy alone for text neck syndrome, improving craniovertebral and shoulder angles, pain, and ROM. This supports GPR as a complementary approach to existing protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，且随访期较短（4周），可能未能捕捉长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study was single-blinded with a short 4-week follow-up, which may not capture long-term effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Nutrition in Osteoarthritis care: expanding the physical therapist's role in multimodal management.
items.summary: An editorial suggests that physical therapists should expand their role in osteoarthritis care to include nutrition screening and lifestyle interventions, recognizing OA as a multifactorial disease beyond just mechanical wear-and-tear.
items.curatedReason: 由于骨关节炎的炎症和代谢背景日益明确，物理治疗师需要拓宽职责范围，将营养筛查和生活方式干预纳入多模式管理。将营养咨询整合到常规实践中，能为患者提供更全面的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 骨关节炎管理中的营养：物理治疗师在多模式管理中角色拓展
items.summaryZh: 一篇社论建议，物理治疗师应扩大在骨关节炎护理中的作用，将营养筛查和生活方式干预纳入多模式管理，因为骨关节炎不仅是机械性磨损，更是受多种因素影响的疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: Given the growing understanding of OA's inflammatory and metabolic underpinnings, physical therapists should expand their role to include nutrition screening and lifestyle interventions in multimodal management. Integrating nutrition counseling into practice can offer a more comprehensive rehabilitation approach for patients.

items.title: Have conflicts of interest in manual therapy trials for low back pain been transparent? A meta-epidemiological review.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological review of manual therapy trials for low back pain published between 2000 and 2025 found that conflicts of interest were often inadequately disclosed when compared to external searches.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃流行病学研究揭示了手法治疗腰痛试验中利益冲突披露的普遍不足。在评估手法治疗研究的证据时，务必审慎查阅外部资金来源和潜在的利益冲突，因为这些可能影响研究结果的透明度和可信度。
items.titleZh: 腰痛手法治疗试验中利益冲突披露的透明度：一项荟萃流行病学综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 2000 至 2025 年间发表的腰痛手法治疗试验的荟萃流行病学综述发现，与外部查询结果相比，研究中利益冲突的披露普遍不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-epidemiological review highlights widespread under-disclosure of conflicts of interest (COI) in manual therapy trials for low back pain. When evaluating evidence for manual therapy studies, meticulously examine external funding sources and potential COIs, as these can impact the transparency and credibility of study findings.
items.limitation: 该综述仅限于 2000-2025 年间发表的英文试验，可能未能覆盖所有相关研究。
items.limitationEn: This review was limited to English trials published between 2000 and 2025, potentially not covering all relevant studies.

items.title: Focal Muscle Vibration for Upper Limb Spasticity After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies (inception-March 2026) involving adults with post-stroke upper limb spasticity found focal muscle vibration (FMV) has a significant effect (Hedges' g=0.74, 95% CI 0.52-0.97) on reducing spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析基本坐实了局部肌肉振动对卒中后上肢痉挛的积极效果，其效应量为中等。现在你可以更放心地将 FMV 作为辅助干预手段纳入上肢痉挛的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 局灶性肌肉振动对卒中后上肢痉挛的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（截至 2026 年 3 月）发现，局灶性肌肉振动 (FMV) 对卒中后上肢痉挛有显著效果 (Hedges' g=0.74, 95% CI 0.52-0.97)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis largely confirms the positive effect of focal muscle vibration on post-stroke upper limb spasticity, with a moderate effect size (Hedges' g=0.74). You can now more confidently incorporate FMV as an adjunctive intervention in rehabilitation programs for upper limb spasticity.
items.limitation: 异质性分析或不同频率/幅度的具体效果未在摘要中详细说明。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity analysis or specific effects of different frequencies/amplitudes were not detailed in the abstract.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Prestroke Rehabilitation Reserve and Mobility and Self-Care Outcomes After Incident Stroke Across Four International Aging Cohorts.
items.summary: A harmonized longitudinal cohort study (N=7486, mean age 70.0 years) across four international aging cohorts found that lower multidimensional pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve was associated with adverse mobility and self-care status after incident stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项跨国队列研究强调了卒中前康复储备的重要性。它证实了较低的储备与卒中后更差的移动和自理能力相关，提示我们需要更重视早期识别和干预，以增强患者的整体康复潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中前康复储备与卒中后移动和自理能力结局在四个国际老年队列中的关系
items.summaryZh: 一项在四个国际老年队列中进行的统一纵向队列研究（N=7486，平均年龄 70.0 岁）发现，多维度卒中前康复储备较低与卒中后不利的移动和自理能力状况相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multinational cohort study underscores the importance of pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve. It confirms that lower reserve is associated with poorer mobility and self-care outcomes after stroke, suggesting a need for greater emphasis on early identification and intervention to enhance overall rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 由于是观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且康复储备的衡量可能受文化和环境因素影响。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it cannot establish causality, and the measurement of rehabilitation reserve may be influenced by cultural and environmental factors.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Advancing Payment: What the Proposed 2027 Medicare Fee Schedule Means for PTs
items.summary: APTA has released an analysis of the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, highlighting key provisions affecting physical therapists' payment and practice, with a call for member comments by Sept. 14.

items.title: Acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement in tennis players: control, randomized, crossover trials
items.summary: This randomized, crossover trial investigated the acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in tennis players, finding beneficial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于网球运动员，使用弹力带的深蹲和核心训练可以提高赛后激活表现。这意味着你可以在缺乏重阻力器械时，考虑将弹力带训练作为一种有效的赛前热身或训练方案。
items.titleZh: 弹力带深蹲和核心训练对网球运动员赛后激活表现的急性影响：随机交叉对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机交叉对照试验研究了使用弹力带进行深蹲和核心练习对网球运动员赛后激活表现（PAPE）的急性影响，发现有益结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that squat and core exercises using elastic bands can enhance post-activation performance in tennis players. This implies you can consider elastic band training as an effective pre-match warm-up or training alternative when heavy resistance equipment is unavailable.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供具体的样本量和效果量数据，可能影响结果的精确解读。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly provide specific sample size and effect size data, which may affect the precise interpretation of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigated the effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease, suggesting potential neurobiological benefits.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，多学科强化门诊康复项目可能通过影响血浆神经丝和肌因子，对帕金森病患者产生积极的神经生物学效应。这为康复干预的机制研究提供了新的方向。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响：一项探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响，提示可能存在神经生物学益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation programs might exert positive neurobiological effects in Parkinson's disease by influencing plasma neurofilaments and myokines. This opens new avenues for mechanistic research into rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性分析，样本量和干预细节未在摘要中明确，需要进一步的验证性研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis, and details regarding sample size and intervention specifics were not explicit in the abstract, warranting further confirmatory studies.
